best_plan.name: p3
best_plan.rationale: Plan p3 achieved perfect quality (0.0 relative error, matching the target counts) while having the lowest cost among the zero-error plans. It is also faster than p2 and cheaper than both p2 and p4, so it offers the best cost-quality trade-off.

plan_codes.p1:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.filter(lambda row: row["idx"] == "taken_3")
pipeline.sem_map(
    [{
        "name": "sentiment",
        "type": str,
        "description": "Classify the review text sentiment toward the movie as exactly one of: positive, negative, or neutral."
    }],
    model=pz.Model.GPT_4_1_MINI,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.filter(lambda row: row["sentiment"] in ["positive", "negative"])
pipeline.groupby(
    group_by_fields=["sentiment"],
    agg_funcs=["count"],
    agg_fields=["reviewId"]
)
pipeline.project(["sentiment", "count(reviewId)"])
pipeline
